asset_policy.canonical_rule: When a canonical asset exists, use that exact approved asset or an explicitly approved variant. Do not regenerate a similar substitute.
asset_policy.verification_rule: Path, hash, dimensions, mode and variant status must be verified before they are treated as asset metadata.
asset_policy.fingerprint_rule: A verified external/source binary fingerprint may identify the approved asset even when the binary has not yet been ingested into the repository.
asset_policy.unknown_rule: Use null or PENDING_VERIFICATION rather than inventing metadata.
